$comment: GAP-234: the one analytics event table for React, SwiftUI and Compose: each event a part sends and, on each platform, "sent" or why it is not. pnpm analytics:parity:check (scripts/check-analytics-parity.mjs) fails when a platform's source sends an event the table does not mark sent there, or the table marks one sent that the source no longer sends. Kept by hand: change it with the part.
